CHANGE ONLY the two blue eyes to gently fully closed eyelids with natural thin brown lash arcs. Keep eyebrows, face shape, nose, lips, head angle and expression calm and resolute. Preserve EVERY other part: same gold hair, crown, silver armor, blue cape, sword, hands, pose, pixel detail, colors, dimensions, scale, transparent margin, and silhouette. Match the 768x1280 source coordinate layout exactly; do not move/zoom/redraw the character. Both eyes visibly fully shut, no visible blue irises. Real transparent alpha background. No text, no extra effects, no cropping. This asset will align over the original in a continuous blink.
